protocol.primary_score: mean individual-fit log loss over four seeds; not ensemble log loss
protocol.track_selection: minimum mean individual-fit validation log loss across four seeds per map and scale; model name breaks exact ties
protocol.scale_change: gap at 100% minus gap at 20%; positive means narrowed token advantage
protocol.uncertainty: paired global-match bootstrap of mean-seed per-state losses; conditional on fitted models, validation choices and fixed training draw
protocol.application_selection: minimum ensemble validation log loss among all four families at full scale; mean four seed probabilities
protocol.application_scope: descriptive kill-free probability movement in contiguous unresolved intervals; no causal attribution
protocol.study_status: corrected retrospective reanalysis of the v1.0 corpus; the test era had been inspected in the historical v0.1 study; model design fixed on 2026-09-06 before any v1.0 fit
